entries.text: I presently have mixed feelings - tipsy , euphoria and enthusiastic . A perfect combo for the Sunday unwinding . The whole week was mentally and psychologically draining though . It ' s been quite a fun day with family and friends outside enjoying the cool evening breeze .

Feeling neutral , no special feelings at all . Hoping to keep up with the new week ahead . Being an optimistic I wish and pray for the best . My optimism is at a all time high right now with great lookouts ahead .

Currently feeling neutral , no emotional , psychological or mental stress available at the moment with no anxieties or stresses clouding my thoughts , a clear sense of mind and clear sense of purpose . Nothing more nothing less

Today , I feel grateful and appreciative because God gave me another day to live , and I ' m happy because of it . I realize that we should not always let the day pass without thanking our creator . And also to my family for always supporting me and keeping me motivated . I knew my journey to the dream and goals in my life would not be an easy .

I currently feel okay , a little bit hooked up with work chores and getting to   settle down for the day is taking more than I initially expected . I expectedly a warm day with great emotions unfortunately the atmosphere isn ' t as welcoming as it supposed to .

I feel now that I am a person worthy of attention , the I have knowledge and capabilities that are needed in the world , that I can support an intelligent conversation and negotiate like a pro . Notwithstanding the nature of the conversation , I feel so powerful right now after defending a very crucial project in front of guests and VIPs .

Feelings are messages from your body and mind about how you are experiencing something emotionally . They are not right or wrong , good or bad , but are instead a reflection of what is happening in the moment . I am feeling lost . I am not satisfied with myself . I have seen the best version of myself and try to keep it consistent

I am feeling much better now , though tired and sluggish but I consider my current situation and feelings not worst as compared to others . There isn ' t much to do now and nothing stressful . Though tired , fatigued and calm , I experience much inner peace at the moment with less worries over some things I cannot control .

My initial feelings right about now is that I think the day is going to be hard but at the same time easy . I say its going to be hard because , of the level that the work I ' ve got to do . I say its going to be easy because if I focus and complete all of my assignments right then the day will go by easy

Honestly not too well , I feel less affectionate to the the things I used to like , just today I got a text from my sister with a not too good content . It actually feels so horrible to have received such news few hours ago . I ' m just all by myself , quite , calm and composed so as not to draw unnecessary attention and sympathy to myself .
